summary: Test coverage has significant gaps. Unit tests for config and seed are solid. Chat handler unit tests only cover the build_context helper, not the handler itself. No React component tests exist. No Rust integration tests exist. E2E tests are well-structured but the session limit test is slow (49 real round-trips instead of counter injection).

The handler is where all the critical logic lives (validation, rate limiting, Ollama error handling, download 404) and none of it is exercised.

quality_issues.issue: Sends 49 real messages in a loop instead of injecting counter state. Tech spec says 'inject initial counter state at 49' to avoid 50 real round-trips. Current implementation is slow and fragile -- any flakiness in the 49-message loop breaks the test.
quality_issues.recommendation: Expose a way to set initial counter (e.g. via page.evaluate to set React state, or a test-only prop/URL param). Alternatively, use page.addInitScript to stub localStorage or a global.

quality_issues.issue: callCount is declared with 'let' instead of a closure-safe pattern. In Playwright route callbacks, this works because routes run in Node context, but it is fragile if tests are parallelized.
quality_issues.recommendation: Use an object property or atomic counter for robustness.

e2e_playwright.quality_notes: Good use of semantic selectors (getByRole, getByLabel, getByText). Route mocking prevents backend dependency. Clock mocking for retry backoff is correct. Download verification is thorough (href, attribute, suggestedFilename). All 4 tech-spec E2E scenarios are covered.

e2e_session_limit.note: No counter injection, uses 49 real messages

findings.title: chat_handler has zero handler-level unit tests
findings.detail: The chat_handler function contains input validation, rate limiting, Ollama HTTP call, and error mapping -- all critical logic. Only the build_context helper is tested. The tech spec requires mocked Ollama tests (httpmock), input validation boundary tests (2000 exact, empty, missing), and injectable rate limiter tests. None exist.
findings.recommendation: Add axum test utilities (axum::test or tower::ServiceExt) with httpmock for Ollama. Test: (1) valid message -> 200, (2) >2000 chars -> 400, (3) exactly 2000 -> 200, (4) empty message -> 400, (5) missing message field -> 400, (6) Ollama timeout -> 503, (7) Ollama 500 -> 503, (8) rate limit exceeded -> 429.

findings.title: No integration tests exist
findings.detail: The mcp/tests/ directory does not exist. All three tech-spec integration tests are missing: RAG pipeline benchmark, deterministic rate limit, Ollama error propagation.
findings.recommendation: Create mcp/tests/integration.rs (or mcp/tests/ directory with individual files). Use a real SqliteStore + hash embedder for RAG pipeline test. Use pre-saturated governor for rate limit test. Use httpmock for Ollama error test.

findings.title: No React component unit tests
findings.detail: Tech spec requires unit tests for ChatPage (message send/receive, counter, limit, retry) and LandingPage (render, navigation, download URL). No test runner (vitest/jest) is configured in webapp/.
findings.recommendation: Add vitest + @testing-library/react to webapp. Write tests for: ChatPage counter logic, session limit at 50, retry backoff behavior, LandingPage rendering.

findings.title: E2E session limit test uses 49 real round-trips
findings.detail: Tech spec explicitly states 'inject initial counter state at 49, send 1 message' to avoid 50 real round-trips. Current implementation loops 49 times sending messages, making the test slow and fragile.
findings.recommendation: Expose counter injection mechanism (e.g., test-only prop, URL param, or page.evaluate to set React state directly).

findings.title: Two constant-assertion tests in chat.rs add no value
findings.detail: Tests max_message_len_constant and recall_limit_constant simply assert that MAX_MESSAGE_LEN == 2000 and RECALL_LIMIT == 3. These catch nothing that a compile error would not.
findings.recommendation: Remove these tests or replace with tests that exercise the constants through actual handler behavior (e.g., 2001-char message returns 400).

findings.title: download_knowledge_handler not tested
findings.detail: Tech spec requires: artifact exists -> 200 with zip content-type, artifact missing -> 404. No unit tests for this handler exist.
findings.recommendation: Add tests using axum test utilities with a temp file for the zip path.
